title: Live news: Bitcoin drops below 200-week moving average as dollar strength pressures risk assets
content: Bitcoin fell below its 200-week moving average as the Dollar Index held above 103, while gold struggled to recover and oil prices rebounded.

title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep $64 million Aave loan healthy
content: The Nasdaq-listed company has 46,676 ETH backing its borrowings, and the loan could become eligible for liquidation if ether slides to around $1,700.

title: Bitcoin firm Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million, more than its entire market value
content: About 70% of the bitcoin treasury firm’s coins are pledged to the exchange, bought at roughly $118,000 each, and bitcoin now trades under $69,000.

title: Bitcoin ETFs are now down over $1.5 billion in net outflows for the year
content: Recent rapid redemptions explain the market swoon. Bitcoin's spot price fell below $70,000 on Friday, the lowest since August.

title: SpaceX-Tesla merger talks put 30,000 bitcoin back in focus
content: A deal could be announced as soon as December, putting $2.1 billion of bitcoin under one roof, a sliver of what the combined group would be worth.

title: Unocoin keeps deposits and withdrawals halted over suspect transfers
content: Unocoin said the transfers were signed outside BitGo’s platform while its account was frozen, possibly via a wallet recovery feature.

title: Bitcoin returns to 200-week trend line as analyst sees risk of $57.7K next
content: Bitcoin price action interacted with its 200-week simple moving average for the first time since mid-August as it fell below $68,000.

title: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B from Binance hack, disrupts FaceStealer scam
content: Authorities froze over $2.7 billion in Binance hack proceeds, while the separate FaceStealer scam stole over $400 million in 18 months.

title: Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT
content: Jane Street ended Q3 with 19% fewer shares in BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF, and a higher share price lifted the stake’s value to $957 million.

title: Microsoft 365 outage hits Outlook email and Teams calendars worldwide
content: Microsoft began a wider patch rollout Friday as the outage disrupted government email and Microsoft 365 connectors in ChatGPT and Claude.

title: Republican Senator Wants to Freeze AI Data Center Boom as Congress Pushes to Expand It
content: Senator Josh Hawley wants a nationwide construction pause until households are protected from rising power bills, even as Congress advances legislation designed to accelerate America's already massive AI infrastructure buildout.

title: North Korea Stole $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls, DOJ Says
content: The FBI says the “FaceStealer” scheme uses prerecorded footage and AI deepfakes of trusted contacts to trick crypto workers into installing malware on video calls—as the DOJ also moves to seize $1.2 billion from the Binance hack.

title: Strategy Made $19.5 Billion in Profit. So Why Is MSCI Removing It From Stock Indexes?
content: Michael Saylor’s Bitcoin giant is being excluded from major investment benchmarks, raising questions about what qualifies as a business—and whether the decision could slow its Bitcoin buying.

title: Why the Path to Quantum Resistance Runs Uphill for Bitcoin Wallet Makers
content: Trezor CTO Tomáš Sušánka explains the trade-offs of Bitcoin’s leading post-quantum signature scheme.

title: Who Is Colette Kress, Jensen Huang’s Successor as Nvidia CEO?
content: Nvidia’s longtime finance chief inherits its first leadership transition in 33 years, bringing decades of technology experience and Wall Street credibility to a company facing a very public leadership test.
